name: dev-servers
description: A Servers pane for this project's dev servers: what is listening, on which port, since when, with Start, Stop, Restart and Log buttons; names the process holding a port when a command fails with EADDRINUSE. No model calls.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often listening ports and their processes are re-read (lsof and ps only; nothing is started or stopped on a timer).

logDir.title: Log folder
logDir.description: Where servers started from the pane write their output, one folder per project.

stopGraceSeconds.title: Stop grace (seconds)
stopGraceSeconds.description: How long Stop waits after SIGTERM before saying the server is still running. SIGKILL is only sent when Stop is pressed a second time.
